name: 锁定准星光标
title: 锁定准星光标
description: 四段角框组成的光标替身：游荡时贴着光标旋转，落到 .cursor-target 上就吸住目标——角框拉伸到目标盒子加间距、圆角贴合目标圆角、转正吸附到最近的 90°，离开再旋回自由态；中心圆点始终贴住真实指针，data-cursor-label 可浮在角框上方，按下时整体收紧，difference 混合让它在任何底色上都清晰。全部几何由弹簧驱动（吸附时长即弹簧参数），原生光标在作用域内隐藏，触屏设备不渲染，帧循环静止自睡。
cardDescription: 角框准星光标，悬停目标即吸附并贴合其圆角。
keywords: 悬停目标即吸附并贴合其圆角

文档

prompt:
Implement the "TargetCursor" component from zero: a reticle cursor made of four corner brackets that float and spin while roaming free, then snap around whatever `.cursor-target` element the pointer lands on — the brackets stretch to match the element's box (plus a gap), morph to its corner radius, settle axis-aligned, and release with a spin when the pointer leaves. A center dot rides the true pointer, a small label can float above the brackets, clicking squeezes the reticle, and the whole layer draws through a difference blend so it stays visible on any background. Everything is spring-driven on one self-sleeping frame loop; the native cursor hides while the reticle is active. Full specification follows; it must not depend on external pages, videos, images, font files, or off-the-shelf effect components.

## Structure & rendering

- React 18+ with react-dom (createPortal). Two files: TargetCursor.jsx (entry, springs, listeners) and TargetCursor.css (base styles). No iframe.
- The component renders nothing until the device qualifies: it watches the media query (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine); on match it portals a fixed layer into document.body, on mismatch (touch devices) it renders null and the OS cursor stays. The portal re-evaluates when the media query flips.
- Portal root `<div class target-cursor>`: position fixed, inset 0, z-index 2147483647, pointer-events none, mix-blend-mode from the blendMode prop, opacity driven each frame by the presence spring (0 at rest). Children, in paint order:
  - four corner spans `.target-cursor__corner` — absolute at 0,0, box-sizing border-box, border-style solid, border-color var(--target-cursor-color), transform-origin 0 0, will-change transform. Each is an L bracket drawn with borderWidth thickness 0 0 thickness (top + left borders only) and a base rotation of 0 / 90 / 180 / 270 degrees; the frame loop adds the reticle's current angle on top.
  - a dot span `.target-cursor__dot` — round, background var(--target-cursor-color), always centred on the raw pointer.
  - a label span `.target-cursor__label` — 12px/medium, white-space nowrap, colour var(--target-cursor-color).
- All geometry (transforms, sizes, radii, opacity) is written as inline styles from the frame loop; the stylesheet carries no transitions.

## Springs

- Ten spring states ({x, v} pairs): presence, lock, press, centerX, centerY, halfW, halfH, radius, turn (plus a spinSpeed scalar). Integration runs 2 sub-steps per frame: v += (stiffness × (goal − x) − damping × v) × h, x += v × h, h = dt/2, dt clamped to 0.05 s.
- presence → 1 while the pointer is inside scope, else 0 (stiffness 260, damping 32); it scales the root's opacity, so the reticle fades in on entry and out on exit.
- lock → 1 while a target is held. Its spring is tuned by hoverDuration: omega = 4.6 / hoverDuration, snapK = omega², snapC = 2 × 0.62 × omega (damping ratio 0.62 — a fast, slightly soft snap; hoverDuration 0.2 s by default, floored at 0.05). The same snapK/snapC drives halfW, halfH and the centre while locked, and the centre's free follow uses a stiffer 2200 with critical damping.
- press → 1 while the pointer is down and clickEffect is on (stiffness 900, damping 40); it squeezes the bracket extents by 1 − 0.14 × press and shrinks the dot by 1 − 0.35 × press.
- First-sighting seeding: before the pointer is first seen (and again whenever it re-enters from a fully settled rest), all springs snap to their current goals so the reticle never flies in from the origin.
- Self-sleep: the loop stops when the pointer is out, presence/lock/press have settled, and nothing is moving or spinning; any pointer event, scroll, or prop re-render wakes it. Scroll (capture, passive) re-resolves the target under the stored pointer so lock survives scrolling.

## Free roam & lock-on

- Free roam: the bracket square measures size × size px (halfW/halfH = size/2, floored at 4 for size), the corner radius is min(2, cornerSize/4), the centre follows the pointer through the 2200 spring, and turn spins continuously at 2π / spinDuration radians per second — spinDuration 0 disables the spin, and reduced-motion forces the spin speed to 0. The spin speed itself eases toward its goal (rate 3 per second) so starting and stopping are soft.
- Target resolution: the element at the pointer (event target, or document.elementFromPoint after a scroll) is walked up with closest(targetSelector) — default ".cursor-target"; a result outside the container scope is rejected. Locking stores the target's border-top-left-radius and the reticle's current angle rounded to the nearest quarter turn, and zeroes the spin speed.
- Locked pose: the centre's goal is the target's centre, leaning up to 8% toward the pointer when parallaxOn is on; the bracket half-extents become the rect's half-width/height plus padding — swapped (height↔width) whenever the resting quarter turn is odd, because a 90° rotation exchanges the axes; the corner radius goal is the target's radius + max(0, padding) capped at cornerSize when matchRadius is on, else 0; and turn springs from its current angle to the recorded quarter (multiple of 90°) so the brackets land axis-aligned, with the half-extent swap matching that orientation. hoverDuration controls how fast all of this snaps.
- Label: when showLabel is on and the locked target carries a data-cursor-label attribute, the label shows that text, positioned above the bracket box's top-left corner (translateY(-100%) with an 8px gap and a 4px rise driven by the lock spring); its opacity follows the lock progress. Without a target or attribute the label empties.
- Colour: with cursorColorOnTarget set, the CSS variable --target-cursor-color mixes it over cursorColor by the lock progress through color-mix(in oklab, <onTarget> <progress%>, <cursorColor>) — the reticle takes the accent colour as it closes onto a target and fades back otherwise; unset means cursorColor always. The variable is written only when the mixed colour actually changes.
- The dot (dotSize px, 0 hides it) tracks the raw pointer exactly — it stays on the true cursor position even while the brackets lean with parallax.

## Native cursor & scoping

- hideDefaultCursor (default on) injects a <style> tag into the document head whose rule — while the pointer is inside and the prop is on — is `<scope>, <scope> * { cursor: none !important; }`, where scope is `[data-target-cursor-scope]` when a container is set, otherwise html. The scope element carries the data-target-cursor-scope attribute; moving the container prop between elements relocates the attribute, and unmount removes it and the style tag. The rule string is written only when it changes.
- The container prop (an element or a ref object) scopes everything: pointer events only count when the event target sits inside the scope or the coordinates fall within its rect; targets outside the scope are ignored; leaving the scope fades the reticle out. Without a container the whole page is the scope.
- Non-mouse pointer types are ignored, so touch devices never fight the portal (they render nothing anyway). window blur and pointerleave on the document element release the lock, hide the cursor rule and fade the reticle.
- Unmount: cancel the frame, remove every listener (pointermove passive, pointerdown, pointerup, scroll capture passive, pointerleave, blur), remove the injected style, clear the scope attribute. Multiple instances on one page run independently; a per-render effect re-wakes the loop so prop changes apply immediately.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| targetSelector | string | ".cursor-target" | Selector matched with closest() to find lock targets. |
| cursorColor | string | "#ffffff" | Base colour of brackets, dot and label. |
| cursorColorOnTarget | string | - | Accent colour mixed in by lock progress while locked. |
| spinDuration | number | 2 | Seconds per full revolution while roaming; 0 disables the spin. |
| hoverDuration | number | 0.2 | Seconds for the brackets to snap onto a target, floored at 0.05. |
| parallaxOn | boolean | true | While locked, the reticle centre leans up to 8% toward the pointer. |
| hideDefaultCursor | boolean | true | Hides the native cursor over the scope while the pointer is inside. |
| size | number | 36 | Reticle size while roaming, in px, floored at 4. |
| cornerSize | number | 12 | Length of each bracket arm, in px, floored at 2. |
| thickness | number | 3 | Bracket stroke width, in px, floored at 0.5. |
| padding | number | 6 | Gap between the brackets and the locked element's box, in px. |
| matchRadius | boolean | true | Morph the bracket corners to the target's border radius (plus padding, capped at cornerSize). |
| dotSize | number | 4 | Centre dot diameter, in px; 0 hides the dot. |
| blendMode | string | "difference" | mix-blend-mode of the whole layer. |
| showLabel | boolean | true | Show the target's data-cursor-label text above the brackets. |
| clickEffect | boolean | true | Squeeze the brackets and shrink the dot while pressed. |
| container | Element \| RefObject | - | Scope element; defaults to the whole page. |

## Delivery & validation

- Deliver the complete content of TargetCursor.jsx and TargetCursor.css plus install steps and the usage example; no ellipses, no "fill in the core yourself" placeholders.
- Validate: the reticle fades in on pointer entry, spins while roaming and follows the pointer tightly; hovering a target snaps the brackets around its box with the configured gap, morphs to its radius, lands axis-aligned and leans slightly with the pointer; leaving spins it back out; targets match through the selector and data-cursor-label floats above the brackets; cursorColorOnTarget ramps in with lock progress; clicking squeezes brackets and dot; difference blending stays readable on light and dark backgrounds; hideDefaultCursor hides the native cursor only over the scope (or the page) and restores it on exit; touch devices render nothing and keep the native cursor; a container prop scopes both lock and hiding; scroll keeps or re-finds the lock correctly; spinDuration 0, dotSize 0, matchRadius false and showLabel false each behave as documented; reduced motion stops the free spin; rapid target hopping never leaves a stuck lock; unmount removes the injected style, the scope attribute and all listeners; two instances scope independently; 375 / 768 / 1440 wide without overflow.
